traversalSession · starts, stops, syncs and replays traversals
note-preview requests pushed by the UI, popped here
4 Output channels: the audio thread writes, other threads read · Source/Audio/ThreadMessaging
Source/Plugin · exists only while the window is open
the graph view; its EditCanvas base owns the managers
child components, one per node and arrow, held in
MouseListener on the canvas; routes each gesture to its feature
A box inside a box is a member its container owns (by value or by unique_ptr). Dashed outline: exists only some of the time (the editor while its window is open, a pop-up while it shows).
